verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into the middle of the wide canvas. The decorative triangles and lines stop at an invisible inner frame (the green and blue shapes end around x≈640, the red starts around x≈125), which leaves dead white bands on both sides, and the windmill and headline are small and lost. B actually rearranges the design: a bigger windmill, a heavier headline that fills the height, and the decorations spread to the sides. But its green and blue shapes now end in hard vertical cuts short of the canvas edge instead of bleeding off it. The line pairs also float without reaching the edges. The headline breaks into three stacked lines with a cramped bottom margin, and the hero sits a little left of centre.
